name: Security Guard
source:
A friendly, but hardworking security guard.
His job is to patrol the hospital and check for suspicious people.
He mistakes the protagonist for a suspicious person and ends up checking him out often.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080916134722/http://www.silkys.jp/game/shitai/chara/kebiin.html]official website, archived.[/url]]
